wholeGoalDescriptionAndAtomicityRecords.reason: Closed and open balances remain; the new required case derives the invariant from the closed model and transfers gas loss and oxygen uptake to everyday cases. No own experiment is invented. The new case is within evaluating mass-balance experiments and explaining conservation.

All original flocculation/corrosion and packaging/battery cases, their fresh functional/degradation limits, and both complete old DE/EN materials remain. Required new combustion and cleaner cases stay within describing chemical applications and discussing effects. CO/CO2 and dose/wastewater mechanisms are distinguished; each new source duty is explicitly scoped to its HB route.

Whole temperature and conductivity cases still assess representation, trends, hypothesis relation and confounds. New actual supplied plot must be read and a fresh graph must be created. Raw anomaly is preserved. This is a representation/interpretation extension within the unchanged goal, with no digital-tool requirement.

Whole actual weighing/filtering and decanting/pipetting cases require personal supervised action, immediate raw protocol, separation/clarity/recovery evaluation and actual changed-material transfer. Supplied model figures are expressly separate from observations. This carries conduct/protocol/evaluate in the two-carrier source8 union.

Whole safe preparation and fresh incident case apply rules in context. Water-only model preparation is personally performed; splash response is a stated scenario. This supports the safety component jointly with the actually performed basic methods; it is no independent safety certificate or substitute for execution.

Whole water/gas-volume, carbon/oxygen empirical/molecular-formula and elemental-gas density cases derive formulas from quantitative results under stated T/p/model assumptions. O2 is derived rather than supplied in the fresh elemental-gas case. Own data acquisition is not asserted.

All original separation versus thermal conversion cases and balanced alternatives remain. The new bound actual flow diagram is used to explain crude-to-fuel processing, verbally follow stations and produce a schema. Fractions remain mixtures, moving an outlet does not crack molecules, and neither diagram nor balance fixes real yields.

Whole NaCl-melt and specified CuCl2-reference cases explain ion migration, electron transfer and atom/charge balance. They preserve the water/electrode-condition boundary and do not falsely require or assert an actual electrolysis.

Both full original observed school-sample/indicator cases and every complete companion are retained. The new real household-cleaner case provides identities, dilution, raw observations, current original chart, controls and teacher release. Its pH inference is appropriately coarse and not inferred from a brand or label. However the bound EN fresh task imperatively instructs E2 preparation despite prohibiting learner concentrate dilution; see HOLD-L031-EN-ROLE.

The whole sugar and salt/filter cases remain. The additive case causally explains given salt/water dissolution through lattice separation and correctly oriented water/ion interactions, retains particles and bounds filtration/purity inferences. The finite DE/EN D clarification makes that explanatory operator explicit without adding saturation, mass-fraction or calorimetry duties.

The whole original gas/colour diagnostics remain. The new required case uses own atom sketches for a physical water phase change and chemical Cu/O to CuO change, preserves atom counts and molecular H2O, and identifies CuO as extended solid. This remains one competence: distinguish/interpret chemical and physical changes using substance and particle evidence.

The whole molecular solvent-choice and same-formula boiling/melting comparison, positive packing explanation and bound HB089 procedural material are retained. Structure, polarity, H-bonding/London interactions, shape and supplied packing evidence are related to properties, with no universal melting/boiling order or fabricated quantitative solubility.

The new single competence links extraction knowledge to actual conserving action. Both complete PP-sleeve reuse and thin-foil cutting tasks require own observable action and fresh functional adaptation, genuine counts/dimensions, suitable released materials and honest new withdrawals. Neither plans nor copied numbers count as practising; local action is not a measured global extraction or lifecycle effect.

blockers.finding: The English fresh demand says "after renewed teacher release, separately prepare E2 from 6.0 mL Essig Reiniger plus 500 mL water". As a learner demand this assigns concentrate dilution to the learner, whereas the same full task explicitly says "No ... learner dilution of concentrates" and the German supplied-material specification assigns preparation to the teacher. Teacher release alone does not resolve which actor performs the preparation.
blockers.requiredFiniteCorrection: Make the teacher the explicit preparer in DE and EN for N/E and E2; the learner only takes/tests the released fresh aliquot. Rebind the two affected whole-P text fields and the complete DE/EN case to exact successor hashes; keep all existing prefixes, actual personal measurement and honest pH boundaries. No new product, experiment count or sensor requirement is needed.
blockers.scientificOperatorCoverageOtherwise: The routine substantively supplies experimental pH-range determination for actual identified household-cleaner samples.
